For C6H14 (hexane), the structural isomers (not counting stereoisomers) are:

1. n-hexane (straight chain): CH3-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3
2. 2-methylpentane: CH3-CH(CH3)-CH2-CH2-CH3
3. 3-methylpentane: CH3-CH2-CH(CH3)-CH2-CH3
4. 2,2-dimethylbutane: CH3-C(CH3)2-CH2-CH3
5. 2,3-dimethylbutane: CH3-CH(CH3)-CH(CH3)-CH3

These are the 5 possible arrangements of the carbon atoms in C6H14 when considering only structural isomers (constitutional isomers) and excluding stereochemistry.
